faqs.q: Do I need a referral for a remedial massage?
faqs.a: No referral is needed. You can book directly with us through our online booking system.

faqs.q: Can I choose my practitioner?
faqs.a: Yes, during the booking process, you can select the practitioner who feels right for you.

faqs.q: Is Hot Stone Massage safe for everyone?
faqs.a: Hot Stone Massage is generally safe for most people. However, it may not be suitable for individuals with certain medical conditions, such as severe hypertension or diabetes. Please consult with your therapist before the session.

faqs.q: How often should I receive a Hot Stone Massage?
faqs.a: The frequency of Hot Stone Massage sessions depends on your individual needs and wellness goals. Some people benefit from monthly sessions, while others may prefer more frequent appointments.

faqs.q: How do I prepare for a Hot Stone Massage session?
faqs.a: Wear comfortable clothing and communicate any specific concerns or areas of pain to your therapist. This will allow them to tailor the session to your needs.

faqs.q: Can we request specific practitioners?
faqs.a: Absolutely, you can choose your preferred practitioners during booking.

faqs.q: What should I expect during a Reiki Massage session?
faqs.a: During a Reiki Massage session, you will lie comfortably while the therapist uses gentle hand placements to channel healing energy. You may experience sensations of warmth, tingling, or deep relaxation.

faqs.q: Is remedial massage painful?
faqs.a: It can involve some discomfort, especially when targeting trigger points, but it is generally tolerable and beneficial.

faqs.q: Where will the couple’s massage take place?
faqs.a: Our practitioners come to your location, whether it’s a hotel, Airbnb, or holiday letting.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need to see results?
faqs.a: The number of sessions required depends on the severity of your condition and your response to treatment. Our therapists will work with you to create a treatment plan tailored to your needs.

Enhanced relaxation can be achieved through float therapy, a deeply relaxing and rejuvenating practice that offers numerous benefits for overall wellness. Float therapy involves immersing oneself in a sensory deprivation tank filled with a solution of warm water and Epsom salt, creating a buoyant environment that allows the body to effortlessly float.

One of the key benefits of float therapy is its ability to induce a state of deep relaxation. By eliminating external distractions and providing a weightless sensation, float therapy promotes a sense of calm and tranquillity, reducing stress, anxiety, and tension in the body. This deep relaxation can also help alleviate symptoms of chronic pain and promote faster recovery from injuries.

Another advantage of float therapy is its impact on sleep quality. Many people struggle with sleep disorders or find it difficult to unwind and fall asleep. Massage therapy, offered by companies such as Massage Me Now, is a popular non-pharmacological method for pain management. It involves the manipulation of soft tissues to reduce muscle tension, improve circulation, and promote relaxation, leading to pain relief and increased well-being.
